Where to register

Ten cities, one comparison

These are the cities where foreign founders actually register. Each is assessed on the same dimensions — address supply, banking practice, permit processing and sector mix — so that a comparison between two of them means something.

At a glance

Compare on the practical numbers

Indicative address costs and setup times for a small service company, compiled from public listings and practitioner reports. They are ranges, not quotes.

CityRegionRegistered addressTypical setupBest suited to
Shanghai
上海		 Yangtze River Delta ¥10k–35k / year 3–6 weeks Professional services, consumer brands, finance-adjacent software and any founder who needs a lawyer, an accountant and a bank relationship in the same week.
Beijing
北京		 Jing-Jin-Ji ¥12k–40k / year 4–8 weeks Education, media-adjacent services, policy-facing research, government-relations consulting and anything whose customer is an institution.
Shenzhen
深圳		 Greater Bay Area ¥6k–22k / year 2–5 weeks Hardware, software,跨境 e-commerce, supply-chain technology and any founder who wants to be within an hour of the factory that makes their product.
Guangzhou
广州		 Greater Bay Area ¥6k–20k / year 3–6 weeks Import/export, wholesale, food and beverage, consumer goods and trading companies that need a real port and a real market.
Hangzhou
杭州		 Yangtze River Delta ¥5k–16k / year 3–6 weeks E-commerce, consumer brands, SaaS, live commerce and supply-chain software; anything that sells through Alibaba's ecosystem.
Chengdu
成都		 Western China ¥4k–12k / year 3–6 weeks Software, games, design, education, tourism and consumer brands targeting western China; founders optimizing for quality of life and runway.
Suzhou
苏州		 Yangtze River Delta ¥5k–15k / year 3–6 weeks Manufacturing, hardware, biotech, precision engineering and any founder whose factory is in the Yangtze River Delta.
Wuhan
武汉		 Central China ¥3k–10k / year 4–8 weeks Optics, photonics, biotech, software and logistics serving central China; founders who need a large engineering talent pool at low cost.
Chongqing
重庆		 Western China ¥3k–10k / year 4–8 weeks Manufacturing, automotive, electronics, logistics along the Yangtze and consumer brands serving western China.
Xi'an
西安		 Northwest China ¥3k–9k / year 4–8 weeks Tourism, education, cultural products, software and anything serving northwest China.

Ranges, not appraisals. Address costs move with district supply, and setup time depends on the licence. Check the specific district before you use any number here in a budget.

A city is not a market. It is a registry counter, a bank branch, and a set of inspectors who will visit your address.
